There are three different types of iron, which is heme iron, non-heme iron or plant-based, and synthetic. Synthetic iron is often found in fortified cereals and a lot of supplements because it's the cheapest to make. but it's also the worst type. It has the worst bioavailability, so it's going to float around in your bloodstream, trick your lab results, but your body will not actually use it. It can also trigger constipation and GI upset, and it is affected further by blockers.
